summary: Closed the invoice reversal/tax-credit implementation boundary as a docs-only slice grounded in ADR 0015 and the merged PH-252 invoicing implementation. The spec now records what PH-252 already delivers (Invoice/InvoiceLine/InvoiceAllocation/InvoiceReversal/TaxQualification append-only models; record/allocate/reverse services with request_token receipts, company lock, expected_version, period/lock checks, role matrix and history_read; reversal only for active invoices, partial/full, exact negative mirrors, no double/over reversal, and no revenue/cash/ledger/open-item writes) so later slices must not reimplement it. It freezes what remains unimplemented and must be delivered by follow-up slices: tax-qualification confirmation with open-period costing-owner adjustment (no invoicing direct ledger/cost write), reversal cross-owner orchestration (management-revenue reversal, cash refund, settlement adjustment) via named owner services with reference-based reconciliation rather than a false single-transaction guarantee, a possible standalone red-letter invoice entity requiring a canonical extension and its own planning, and read-only invoice/settlement/revenue/tax pairing owned by PH-325. It maps PH-320 (orchestration follow-up, proposed), PH-325 (read-only pairing, proposed), PH-321 (multi-currency, ready) and this closure, and adds acceptance/counterexample rules. No code, migration, route, contract-schema or applied-migration change.
